GEONOR AS – Company Profile
Geonor was established in 1957 by NGI (Norwegian Geotechnical Institute) and the Norwegian University of Science and Research (NTNF). The basic idea was that Geonor would be responsible for the production and sale of equipment for geotechnical field and laboratory investigations developed at NGI, which had been established four years earlier. Both NGI and Geonor were established as part of NTNFs longstanding efforts to address the practical and technical problems in rebuilding Norway after World War II.
NGI's first director, Danish-born Laurits Bjerrum (1918-1973), was both the driving force behind the creation of Geonor and its first chairman.He had a great impact on NGI, Geonor and geotechnical research. Since the beginning, Geonor has focused on Bjerrum`s ideas of production and sale of reliable and advanced equipment with high quality. Quality and innovation were key values.
NGI was part owner of Geonor from 1957 to 1997. Norwegian Hydro came in as a partner in 1960 and was the principal shareholder from 1989 to 1997. Øyvind Klevar became managing director in 1993 has been the owner of the company since 1997.
Geonor has been a pioneer in the development of geotechnical field equipment (vane testers and borers, soil sampling), geotechnical drilling rigs, geotechnical laboratory equipment, and in particular geotechnical and meteorological instrumentation based on the vibrating-wire technology. Key partners in this development have been NGI, the Public Roads Administration and the Norwegian Meteorological Institute.
Geonor manufactures and sells geotechnical, hydrological, meteorological and environmental equipment. We deliver quality through cost effective solutions based on our own and third party products. Geonor is certified according to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015.
Our main customers are government agencies and institutes, consultants, universities and colleges, contractors and other system integrators. 
Our proven solutions are constantly developed by combining the new sensors, wireless communications and Internet-based solutions. We present new solutions for remote monitoring of pore pressure and groundwater level in large ongoing infrastructure projects and based on IoT LoRa WAN technology.
An increasing number of road, rail, infrastructural and natural hazards projects are leading to greater need for site investigations and monitoring of soil conditions and structures. We already deliver a wide range of instrumental solutions for the monitoring of natural forces that threaten society's infrastructure. Climate change and more extreme weather increase the need for automated monitoring and additional measuring points.
Geonor markets and sells its products worldwide and have exported equipment to over 100 countries. The company is the only geotechnical company in the Nordic countries that can show more than 60 years of continuous operations. The company is located in Grini Næringspark in Bærum on the outskirts of Oslo.

Alis is a service and consultancy company in the areas of occupational safety, industrial hygiene and training. Alis represents the development of a project that has lasted for more than 20 years and which has a wealth of experience under its belt; it operates across the whole Italian territory and in different sectors (trade, health, construction, transport, food, environment, energy) both in the public and private sectors. It brings together qualified professionals with different skills but all offering a cohesive set of integrated and flexible services that act as a solution to support requests made by the customer
Alis is able to offer a wide range of technical consultancy and training services, characterized by some specialized skills relating to the measurement of chemical, physical and biological pollutants in living and working environments, such as chemicals, asbestos noise, vibrations, microclimate, lighting, air quality in general, electromagnetic fields, radon, microbiological contaminants such as legionella, mold and bacterial charges; also it provides management support for the regulatory requirements related to environmental protection, safety and health at the workplace.
At this time of emergency for the Coronavirus pandemic, ALIS with its group companies, is one of the activities considered essential by Presidential Decree on an important research and development in order to oppose the Covid-19.
ALIS is in the front row for the study of the Personal Protective Devices necessary to combat the spread of the virus, it develops technical, organizational and procedural measures for companies that cannot stop production but must guarantee the safety of the workplace; Alis Group companies carry out sanitization and disinfection activities ensuring the result of the intervention by means of a certified test to verify the effectiveness of the reduction of the virological load by means of real time PCR analysis.
The ALIS Group held for over 10 years activities aimed at verifying the quality of air, water and physical contaminants, chemical and biological processes using an experimental methodology: inspection of qualified technicians, context evaluation, sampling, laboratory analysis, processing of results by comparison with legal values and regulatory interpretation.
The experimental and analytical verification of the data through its laboratories is among the distinctive elements of the ALIS group; The ALIS laboratory is recognized by the Ministry of Health and is in possession of the necessary Ministerial authorizations for carrying out specific analyzes on asbestos while the other partner laboratories are in possession of specific sector authorizations (e.g. Accredia certifications).
The quality of the working method, the security of the data, the certainty of the result and the guarantee of the evaluation approach has allowed ALIS to provide services for important companies on the national territory such as: Unicredit SpA – Ambasciata Australiana - RAI - Tubilux, FAO, IFAD, ATAC S.p.A Azienda per la mobilità, Hotel dei Borgognoni - Cassa Forense - Impresa Costruzioni Giuseppe Maltauro – Condotte SpA - ITC Farma di Pomezia - Camera Deputati, OSA Operatori Sanitari Associati, Alstom Ferroviaria, Cassa Depositi e Prestiti - Hotel Cavalieri Hilton di Roma – Plastipak - BNP Paribas - Aeronautica Militare - Guardia di Finanza - Roma Capitale - Ospedale Bambino Gesù - Postemobile SpA - Coni Servizi Spa - Banca D'Italia - EUR SpA - NUCLECO SpA - ISTITUTO LUCE - CINECITTA' S.r.l - TELECOM Italia SpA, Telespazio.
Our offices and laboratories are located in Via Giannetto Valli 93 in Rome. The owner of ALIS srl is dr. Matteo Mazzali.

The aim is to promote all levels of green on buildings through communication, demonstration projects, business incubators, law and policies activities – not only on national, but also on European level. The intention is to upscale and share the results with all partners in the European network and market (knowledge transfer). The instruments of GRÜNSTATTGRAU include a large-scale demonstration testbed, the entirely green implemented neighbourhood in Vienna, a moving Green Laboratory on roadshow and a multi-stakeholder online platform to develop and offer own supporting tools, services and technologies. GRÜNSTATTGRAU operates non-profit-orientated and 100% owned by VfB (Austrian Green Roof and Living Wall Association- NPO led by 12 elected board member experts who support and supervision GRÜNSTATTGRAU with their expertise). GRÜNSTATTGRAU GmbH was founded to coordinate the Austrian Green Living Laboratory “GRÜNSTATTGRAU” – Innovations for Green Cities“ Project initially. The umbrella project, supported by the Austrian Ministry for Climate, Environment, Energy, Transport, Innovation and Technology is set for five years (2017-2022), including over 300 network partners in the fields of economy, R&D and city administration in Austria and several international network supporters, for example the European Federation of Green Roof and Living Wall Associations EFB and its national members. The first level target Area is a densely sealed up neighbourhood in Vienna (Kretaviertel), other synergy areas are for example the cities of Graz, Innsbruck, Klagenfurt, St. Pölten, Linz, Salzburg and Feldkirch. We expect new impulses for the European network for exchange and cooperation with scientific and business partners, public institutions and administration units. The Green Living Lab GRÜNSTATTGRAU represents an innovative approach for facilitation and multiplication of national, European and global interests in Climate Change adaptation/Mitigation through Green Infrastructure and Nature Based Solutions. GRÜNSTATTGRAU is led by two women (Vera Enzi, Landscape Architect and Susanne Formanek, Sustainable Construction Expert) and supported by an interdisciplinary team of employees. The network Partners as well contribute their knowledge and support to GRÜNSTATTGRAU in form of 3 board units (Business, Science, Advisory).

Sundance Multiprocessor Technology Ltd., was founded in 1989 and has 1000’s of man-years of experience operating as an Electronics Contract Manufacturer (ECM) for Original Equipment Manufactures (OEM) and Commercial-of-the-shelf (COTS) boards with low margins and a high volume of boards for a broad range of customers.
In 2014 we wanted to move more towards becoming an Engineering company with fewer people (2020 = x11 people) and adding more value to each development. Sundance has been working with both industry and the academia and therefore has proven (through the success of previous projects) that it is the ideal partner for knowledge transfer. Sundance’s team is composed of multi-disciplinary and high qualified staff that delivers innovative solutions, specially designed, for designing innovative embedded hardware platforms using state-of-art-technologies for accelerating innovative artificial Intelligence algorithms. Sundance’s solutions include highly efficient and low power consumption embedded platforms optimised for running deep learning algorithms used for performing autonomous navigation and for other general computer vision applications. Such solutions are fundamental for the new generation of robotics and autonomous systems.
The focus of Sundance is still Multiprocessing Technology and our keyword technologies/interest are: 
1. Vision System and sub-components for safety

3. Robotics electronics for control and unmanned vehicles 
4. Deep Learning and Edge-AI

Armatus Oceanic’s continuing mission is to develop and deploy underwater technology to allow the exploration and surveying of up to 11,000 meters below the ocean’s surface.
